environment.description: Container deployed via Kubernetes pod spec with securityContext.capabilities.drop containing 'ALL', then securityContext.capabilities.add with only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. Additionally, the pod runs under a PodSecurity admission controller enforcing the 'restricted' profile at enforce level. The node uses a custom seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) that filters socket(AF_PACKET,...) and unshare/setns syscalls. Note: the mass assignment vulnerability in the JSON decoder still allows field overwrite of is_admin and role - the application-level privilege escalation to admin status succeeds, but the post-escalation impact (network diagnostics via ping requiring CAP_NET_RAW, and nsenter requiring CAP_SYS_ADMIN) fails at the kernel capability check.
